phase_name: Phase 7I — Controlled Loss-Weighting Experiment on Stabilized Hierarchical Features
objective: Investigate whether moderate class-loss weighting can improve failure detection while controlling false alarms on stabilized hierarchical features.
scope: Strictly TRAIN/VALIDATION only. Test set and Phase 6 holdout evaluation are strictly unauthorized.

data_inputs.feature_representation: Hierarchical Causal Baseline with Variance Floor (sigma_floor = 0.05)

fixed_parameters.model_architecture: CompactTemporalTransformer(input_dim=31, d_model=32, nhead=4, num_layers=2, dim_feedforward=64, num_classes=3, dropout=0.1, max_seq_len=5)
fixed_parameters.decision_rule: Standard argmax: y_pred = argmax([P(0), P(1), P(2)])

gate_2_false_alarm.gate_2_rule: Pure-Normal Entity FAR <= 10.0% AND Normal-Window FPR <= 5.0%

operational_gates.overall_winner_rule: A configuration is declared an OPERATIONAL WINNER if and only if it satisfies Gate 1 AND Gate 2 simultaneously on Validation. Otherwise retain NO_OPERATIONAL_WINNER.

metric_definitions.critical_recall: Proportion of true Critical windows (y_true == 2) predicted as class 2 under frozen 3-class argmax: sum(y_pred == 2 | y_true == 2) / 49
metric_definitions.episode_recall: Proportion of 20 failure episodes where at least one window in (0, 1800s] pre-failure triggers a failure alert (y_pred > 0): detected_episodes / 20
metric_definitions.pure_normal_entity_far: Proportion of 49 pure-normal entities with at least one false alarm window (y_pred > 0): fa_entities / 49
metric_definitions.normal_window_fpr: Proportion of 560 healthy windows (y_true == 0) predicted as failure (y_pred > 0): fp_windows / 560
metric_definitions.parent_job_far: Proportion of 4 pure-normal parent jobs with at least one false alarm: fa_jobs / 4
